findings.summary: The new os.Chmod runs on every SaveUploadedFile call, even without perm, and chmods the existing parent directory (e.g. '.', '/tmp', '/'), which can fail with EPERM or alter shared directory permissions; it should apply only to directories MkdirAll created and only when perm is passed.

judge.reason: Describes chmod on existing parent directories (e.g. /tmp) failing with EPERM or altering permissions, the same defect as b1.

findings.summary: The perm argument is applied only to the directory and never to the saved file (still created with os.Create default mode), which is misleading; a value like 0o644 leaves the directory untraversable, and only perm[0] is used with extra values silently ignored.

judge.reason: Perm not applied to the file is a design complaint and the ignored extra variadic values is a known problem; it doesn't describe the chmod-on-existing-dir bug.
